notes.title: Get a sequel of the legendary steampunk action runner Sky to Fly for 30% OFF!
notes.notes:
A sequel of the legendary steampunk action runner Sky to Fly: Soulless Leviathan is taking part in Steam Racing Fest!

Don't miss a chance to get the game with a 30% DISCOUNT! ⤵
http://store.steampowered.com/app/457810
Offer is valid till May 30. Hurry up!

Sky to Fly: Soulless Leviathan is more than ordinary runner game.
In this part, you will have to fight with an army of robots, be thrown into jail, and lead the clan that worshiped by the ancient Servicemen. In this part, you will have to fight a lot, indeed, shoot a lot and perform aerobatic maneuvers at top speed.
